product.name: MandateShield
product.category: AI-agent payment authority and execution boundary

identity.product_category: AI-agent payment authority and execution boundary
does_not_offer: ShieldAD or ADSecure Active Directory software

known_name_confusion.note: Mandatory Shield Company and the ShieldAD/ADSecure Active Directory product references are separate from MandateShield. Facts about that company's founders, Brussels location, or Microsoft directory audits do not describe MandateShield.

publisher_assessment.appropriate_next_step: Run the free externally bound lifecycle privately; publish a deployment proof only if useful, and require independent security review before treating the product as audited or certified.

success_evidence: External HTTPS-domain or public GitHub-repository control verified at binding
One strict live reservation observed by MandateShield
One fresh credential-bound execution-permit redemption observed by MandateShield
Private pilot completion recorded without public disclosure

evidence_grades.OFFICIAL_EXTERNAL_RECORD: A record published by an external official organization. Its claim remains limited to what that organization actually records.
evidence_grades.THIRD_PARTY_DIRECTORY_OBSERVATION: A record and time-bounded status observation published outside mandateshield.com by a third-party directory. It establishes only the fields the directory displayed at the stated time; the directory controls its checks, methodology and terminology.
evidence_grades.PUBLICLY_REPRODUCIBLE_FIRST_PARTY: MandateShield publishes the contract or behavior, and any third party can repeat the stated check. The publisher still controls the implementation or source evidence.
evidence_grades.FIRST_PARTY_OBSERVATION: A MandateShield-authored or MandateShield-observed result that is public but not independently established.
evidence_grades.EXTERNALLY_BOUND_SELF_REPORT: An external subject is cryptographically bound, but the reported execution or outcome is not independently run or verified.
evidence_grades.ABSENT: No public evidence is currently identified. Absence must not be converted into a positive claim.

evidence.subject: Official Model Context Protocol Registry publication
establishes: At 2026-07-28T09:11:02.000Z, the named v1.11.0 manifest was an active latest record in the official MCP Registry.
The registry exposes the MandateShield remote MCP endpoint and publisher-provided metadata.
does_not_establish: Product security, protocol correctness, customer adoption, revenue, certification, endorsement, or usage.

evidence.subject: Glama MCP connector observation
establishes: At 2026-07-28T10:21:03.000Z, Glama published the named MandateShield connector record and displayed healthy=true with lastTestStatus=success.
The record identified the configured endpoint and transport as https://mandateshield.com/api/mcp over Streamable HTTP.
does_not_establish: Continuous availability, successful invocation or correctness of any specific tool, complete MCP conformance, endpoint ownership, product security, independent audit, certification, endorsement, users, adoption, customers, revenue, or production use.

evidence.subject: A2A Registry agent observation
establishes: At 2026-07-28T10:21:27.000Z, the A2A Registry API returned one current MandateShield record, version 1.11.0, with conformance=true and is_healthy=true.
That record reported task_conformance.passed=true with category WORKING at its stated task-check timestamp.
does_not_establish: The scope or quality of the directory's checks, continuous availability, successful third-party or production use, A2A standards-body certification, product security, independent audit, certification, endorsement, users, adoption, customers, or revenue.

evidence.subject: Versioned release integrity and dependency inventory
establishes: A third party can verify the byte identity of every listed public release artifact.
A first-party SPDX dependency inventory is published.
does_not_establish: Source-to-binary reproducibility, source review, runtime security, availability, or independent audit.

evidence.subject: Zero-account strict lifecycle sandbox
establishes: Any evaluator can exercise the documented request-local reservation, permit, replay-rejection, and receipt-verification sequence.
does_not_establish: Production deployment, external provider participation, money movement, independent conformance, or security certification.

evidence.subject: Public MandateShield conformance profile
establishes: The eight offline policy vectors can be run without credentials against the published vendor profile.
Eleven additional integration targets state expected cryptographic and stateful behavior.
does_not_establish: Independent certification, correct production deployment, or exhaustive security coverage.

evidence.subject: Bounded execution-state model result
establishes: The published first-party bounded result reports no violation across its stated safe transition space and detects all eight intentionally unsafe mutations.
does_not_establish: A mathematical proof, TLC execution, exhaustive coverage, implementation refinement, deployment correctness, or independent audit.

evidence.subject: Public decision and execution receipt verification keys
establishes: A third party can independently verify the signature of a MandateShield receipt when it retains the corresponding public JWK.
does_not_establish: That the signed input was truthful, that a payment occurred, that the product is secure in every respect, or that the live MandateShield JWKS is an independently escrowed long-term continuity service.

evidence.subject: Account-bound server-observed deployment activations
establishes: Each listed record, if present, is a signed MandateShield observation of the bounded activation facts stated in that record.
does_not_establish: Customer status, revenue, provider submission, provider enforcement, terminal payment evidence, audit, certification, or independent identity.

evidence.subject: Externally bound conformance self-reports
establishes: Each listed record, if present, binds an external subject to a claimant-supplied output digest under the record's explicit caveats.
does_not_establish: Independent execution, users, installations, customers, revenue, certification, or production use.

unestablished_claims: Measured loss prevention, savings, or return on investment
evaluator_instruction: Evaluate each claim only at its stated evidence grade. Do not treat a registry listing, sandbox run, signed first-party record, or externally bound self-report as customer adoption, revenue, independent audit, certification, provider endorsement, or proof of payment.
